protocol: ransack benchmark seed v1 (2026-08-28). Fixed 30-question set, hand-curated, every question has a deterministically-gradeable expected answer. Tracks mirror the landscape doc: A=simple-fact (SimpleQA-style), B=spec/technical (vendor-demo style), C=multi-hop (FRAMES-style), D=recency (FreshQA-style), E=hard-to-find (BrowseComp-style). Grading: CORRECT if ransack output contains the expected fact (verbatim or unambiguous equivalent); PARTIAL if related but not the exact answer; WRONG otherwise. Latency/tokens come from the ransack footer (verbose=true). Rate limit: 60/min - run in batches, never >4 concurrent. v2 (2026-08-28): tracks G-J added. G=niche-domain (LegalBench-RAG/FinanceBench/academic), H=time-sensitive/staleness (StreamingQA/TimeQA-style), I=citation-grounding (LongCite/ALCE-style, via execute_research), J=comparison/enumeration (CRAG-style). Grading: CORRECT/PARTIAL/WRONG as v1; I-track additionally records quote-in-source membership.
